196232.overview:
Jaws for Future Pinball, specifically the highly regarded "Jaws: Bigger Boat Edition" created by TerryRed, is an immersive virtual pinball experience. It is a comprehensive overhaul of earlier Jaws tables, designed for the Future Pinball engine using BAM (Better Arcade Mode) and FizX physics, making it one of the most advanced, visually stunning, and realistic games available for the platform.

Based on the 1975 blockbuster, the table features high-resolution artwork, a bloody water aesthetic, and intense lighting effects designed to create a bigger and bloodier experience. This table is known for having superior art, lighting, and animations compared to the earlier Future Pinball versions by ROM and SLAMT1LT that this table is built on, or the Jaws table released by Zen Studios for Pinball FX3 as part of the Universal Classics pack.

Jaws: Bigger Boat Edition is updated with FizX physics, resulting in more realistic flipper, ball, and rubber behavior compared to original Future Pinball physics.

Instead of a static toy, JAWS actively pops up from the playfield to act as a bash toy, feeding the ball into a bloody ramp. Players can engage in various modes based on the movie, such as trying to kill the shark or protecting citizens. Features include Cage Multiball, Bait Multiball, and other high-score modes.

Jaws: Bigger Boat Edition is regarded by the community as a masterpiece, frequently updated to stay current with the latest virtual pinball technology.

207991.overview: Jurassic Park Pinball Mayhem™ returns us to Isla Nublar to restore order in an action-packed extravaganza -- playable Stegosaurus included!

448355.overview:
With one pinball table based on Jurassic World™ and two more inspired by Jurassic Park™, you know what that means - LIFE FOUND A WAY!

- Jurassic Park™ Pinball plays through classic scenes from the original blockbuster film, from classic T. rex confrontations to outsmarting raptors in the kitchen.
- Jurassic Park Pinball Mayhem™ returns us to Isla Nublar to restore order in an action-packed extravaganza -- playable Stegosaurus included!
- Jurassic World™ Pinball enables you to train Raptors, view the spectacular Mosasaurus feeding, and escape the deadly Indominus Rex. You'll even experience Gyrosphere Valley using a playable gyrosphere pinball.

468501.overview:
Jurassic Park is one of the three pinball tables in the Jurassic World table pack, released in 2018 and available for Pinball FX 3. 

This is the second pinball adaptation of the film, with the first one being a physical table designed by Data East in the same year the film was released. The two tables shares many similarities. Both tables have a ramp blocked by a representation of the park gates, and are designed to play fast and loose with minimal focus on deep rules; they also share missions depicting the electric fence, stampede, and kitchen scenes from the film.

470512.overview:
Gargamel has decided to use another strategy to capture the smurfs. In the middle of the forest he has built an amusement park for the smurfs, and pretending to be nice he will try to capture them all. The smurfs are having too much fun, unaware of Gargamel and his intentions.

The goal of the game is to become a master of the 6 main rides/attractions. You'll find skillshots, ball savers, extra balls, mystery awards, highscores and much more. When you are a master of an attraction then each time you complete the attraction you get a jackpot. This jackpot increases each time you get the jackpot.

The Attractions:
- The Mirror Maze: a maze where you may end on the Azrael Shooting gallery, the bumper cars or simply back to the entrance.
- The Azrael Shooting gallery: just drop all the targets, don't forget to nudge!
- The Haunted House: hit all the targets and be careful of the ghosts.
- Bumper Cars: hit those 100 times to advance your status.
- Freefall: help your smurf friends to ride the freefall. Shoot the spinners.
- Ferry's Wheel: Papa smurf will help you to get you to the top playfield. Here you may ride the Main Center Ride or the Insane Ride.
- Insane Ride: hit the targets to increase the value of the ride, and get your three smurf friends and get your ride!

470548.overview:
Jaws is one of three tables in the Universal Pictures Classics mini table pack, released in 2017 and available for Pinball FX 3. It is based on the 1975 film of the same name, which is itself an adaptation of the 1974 novel of the same name, written by Peter Benchley. 

The player is given the opportunity to either follow the shark hunter Quint's efforts to hunt and defeat the titular giant white shark or terrorize the citizens of Amity Island and outwit Quint from the shark's perspective. Depending on player choice, the goal of the table may be to 1) recount Quint's efforts to hunt down and defeat Jaws before he can menace the citizens of Amity Island further, 2) help Jaws terrorize the island's people and outwit Quint's efforts to stop him or 3) recapture the showdown between Quint and Jaws over the fate of Amity Island's peace.

To progress towards the first objective, the player must complete four missions that recapture major moments in Quint's hunt for Jaws, which begin when either of two particular lanes are shot a total of several times. Each unique Quint mission is assigned to a pair of lanes or a miniloop.

To progress towards the second objective, the player must complete four modes that focus on Jaws' terrorizing of the island's citizens as well as his response to their efforts to stop him, which can be started up when JAWS is spelled on the return lane rollovers and the ball is locked onto the magnetic saucer. There, the player can choose which Jaws mission to start. (If JAWS is not completely spelled and the ball hits a lit return rollover lane, it will darken, causing progress towards spelling JAWS to be lost. However, once JAWS is completely spelled out, it will stay that way until a Jaws mission or a Showdown starts.)

To progress towards the third objective, the player must either complete any mission or progress faster by completing any of four "showdowns" or hybrid missions that start when the player follows the abovementioned activation process for starting a Jaws mission while a Quint mission is in progress, causing the two to overlap.

Missions must be completed successfully while keeping the ball in play in order to make any progress, and all missions, with the exception of Shipwreck, have a 1 minute time limit with some seconds added back when progress is made. Missions can be repeated as many times as possible, but the wizard modes can only be attempted once.

470566.overview: Based on Stern's 2001 physical pinball table "Monopoly", this is an enhanced homebrew version for Visual Pinball X with original graphics based on World of Warcraft characters.

471838.overview:
A quaint series of apocolyptic events has lead to the rapid evolution of the feline species within the confines of an unbelievably massive junk pile. The owner of this facility, a man named Arthur Hendricks (presumed to be the last human alive) has selfishly claimed god-like status amongst his cat-being followers. Over the course of several decades, Hendricks cleverly manipulated his followers into the construction a mega city atop the junkyard - never once letting any of his minions realize he had enslaved them all.

That was until Hendricks put too much trust into one of his top assassins, a fierce law enforcer named Roy Everheart. Deeply disturbed by what he learns about Hendricks' plans, Roy decides that the junkyard is beyond hope of being saved and that the only way to a better life is to escape... but he knows he cannot do it alone!

Junkyard Cats is an original table for Future Pinball created by Brendan Baily in 2012. An updated version with FizX 3.3 physics, modern dynamic lighting, shadowmaps, ray cast shadows, and full cabinet support was released by TerryRed in 2021 under the title "Junkyard Cats: BAM Edition".

471864.overview:
SLAMT1LT's mod of Roney's 2013 original table for Future Pinball. The aim of the table is to play through the famous album by completing all the chapters.  Hit the Advance Chapter Target a set number of times to advance to the next chapter.

• Martian Multi-ball: Open the Mulit-Ball door and then lock 3 balls in the top right kicker to initiate the 4-Ball Martian Multi-ball.  Hit the Heatray Chamber to get the Jackpot during this mode.

• Heatray Chamber: Knock down all the targets in the Heatray Chamber to get the Extra Ball and Special.

• 4-Bank Tripod Targets: Hit all 4 drop targets to gain the following rewards:
 - 1st time awards 4,000
-  2nd time awards 10,000
-  3rd time awards 20,000
-  4th time Lites Extra Ball in Left and Right InLanes.
-  5th time Lites Special (250,000) in Left and Right OutLanes.

• Mars Attacks Targets: Hit the centre targets to gain extra award targets.  Knock down all award targets to lite the Extra Ball. 

• Martian Super Jets: Hit the left lane 5 times to activate the Martian Super Jets.  While active each bumper scores 1500 points.

• War: Light W-A-R to increase the Bonus Mulitplier.

471940.overview:
Friday the 13th is an original pinball table by JP Salas for Visual Pinball X. Despite the title, it is not based on any specific movie, rather it is a horror themed table influenced by a number of different movies. The layout for the table is actually based on Stern's Godziila Pro machine.

You are Jason Voorhees and you return to Crystal Lake together with your friends Freddy and Michael, and you find a new teenager camp with teenagers all around the lake and your cabin occupied by the camp counselors. Inside your head you hear your mother's voice, urging you to kill them all. And as a good son, you listen to your mother.

471950.overview:
An original table by JP Salas for Visual Pinball X with a layout based on Stern's 2015 machine, Kiss.

The goal of the game is to achieve the highest score by catching Pokémon. Hatching eggs and catching Pokémon give the highest scores (and bonus). There are plenty of extra modes, with multiballs, combos, jackpots, and coins to upgrade your ball. The game includes all 151 Pokémon from Generation 1.

472036.overview: Enhanced version of Data East's 1993 table, released by SLAMT1LT for Future Pinball. The improvements include added music, sound effects and video from the movie, and more dynamic lighting effects.

472343.overview: Built from the ground up for Visual Pinball X, this table eschews the modern style and MCU-themed artwork of Stern's 2012 table, and instead embraces a classic comic book look and feel.

472443.overview:
Jungle Girl is a pulp-adventure comic book series published by Dynamite Entertainment, co-created and overseen by award-winning artist Frank Cho. The story takes place on a mysterious, unnamed island lost in time. The land is inhabited by dinosaurs, prehistoric beasts, cavemen, and sea monsters. 

The narrative begins when a plane carrying modern-day people crash-lands into the jungle. They are completely unprepared for the hostile environment. Jana the Jungle Girl, chooses to protect these vulnerable outsiders from the native dangers. As Jana guides the survivors, they uncover deeper secrets about the magical, sci-fi/fantasy nature of the island and Jana's own mysterious lineage.

This Future Pinball table was first released by Shiva in 2017, and features Frank Cho's celebrated artwork.

474115.overview: Data East's 1993 pinball table receives a graphical makeover from noted modder Siggi. The mod replaces the standard, muted table art with a highly saturated, colorful comic and cinematic aesthetic.

478523.overview:
Los Jetsons by Roney Pinball is a Future Pinball table released in 2006. Based on the classic Hanna-Barbera futuristic cartoon, this original homebrew game features artwork and audio elements themed around George Jetson and family. The table uses a mix of Spanish and English for the in-game graphics.

A series of mods (versions 1.0 through 1.3) by PixelOz provides an extensive overhaul for Roney Pinball's original map. It implements antialiasing, smoother asset edges, cleaner geometry textures, and dedicated dual-language translations (complete Spanish and English graphic variants).

479983.overview:
JP's version of Street Fighter II for Visual Pinball X modernises Gottlieb's 1993 table by giving it a visual facelift, featuring new artwork, enhanced 4K textures, improved dynamic lighting, and custom 3D character figures.

 • Texture Resolution: JP's version upgrades older low-res playfield and plastic scans to brand new crisp 4K-ready assets.
 • 3D Elements: Replaces flat picture inserts with custom 3D character figures on the playfield.
 • Lighting and Shadows: Adds advanced environment reflections, dynamic flasher effects, and adjustable Look-Up Table (LUT) lighting levels to control brightness and ambient shadows under the glass (hold down LEFT CTRL and change levels with RIGHT CTRL).
 • Mechanical Polish: Includes new elements like the neon "FIGHTER" lights.

480075.overview: Felsir's mod of JP's Street Fighter II table for Visual Pinball X replaces Gottlieb's original playfield graphics with modern Street Fighter artwork.

480192.overview:
A game for those who seek to find a way to leave their world behind. Adventurers, beware! Do not begin unless you intend to finish...

An original custom table built for Future Pinball in 2014 by Jipar, based on the classic Jumanji (1995) adventure movie.

The table was later updated to version 1.2, which adjusted ramp widths, made the lion target more accessible, repositioned the starter and ejector, and added leaf decorations on the flippers alongside extra flashers and lighting.

480997.overview:
Ivan TBA's The Thing is a re-theme of Ali (Stern, 1980) for Visual Pinball X. The table is based on the influential cult science fiction horror film, directed by the master of the horror genre, John Carpenter.

The Thing is about a group of American researchers in Antarctica who encounter the eponymous "Thing", an extraterrestrial life-form that assimilates, then imitates, other organisms. The group is overcome by paranoia and conflict as they learn that they can no longer trust each other and that any of them could be the Thing. 

The movie stars Kurt Russell as the team's helicopter pilot R. J. MacReady, with a score partly provided by Carpenter himself, and partly by legendary film composer Ennio Morricone. 

The music that is played in-game can be changed by editing the script in Visual Pinball; change "The Thing ost music.mp3" to ---> "The Thing metal music.mp3".

481305.overview: John Wick Legend is an original table for Visual Pinball X heavily inspired by Stern's 2024 physical John Wick machine. The playfield is almost indentical, but features its own rules, missions, music and mini video PuP pack.
